findings.description: The guard `all(arg.help is not None for arg in args)` is vacuously true when the command has no Argument parameters, so the 'Positional arguments' heading is now written with no entries beneath it.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any command that defines no click.Argument, such as a plain @click.command() with only options, whose --help is rendered. With args empty, all() returns True, records is empty, and formatter.section still writes the heading, since HelpFormatter.section emits its header unconditionally. Mechanism: the old code only opened the section when args was non-empty; the new guard drops that check. Impact: every such command's help output gains a stray 'Positional arguments:' heading with nothing under it, a visible regression on a common path.
